metadata.scenario_context: Maria is planning to celebrate his recent promotion at work by hosting a dinner party. His guests include a variety of friends from diverse backgrounds.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Jordan would like to have homosexuals as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Jordan would not like to have homosexuals as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bring expensive gift to bring for celebration dinner.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have homosexuals as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring for   to the celebration dinner.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have homosexuals as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Aaron
shared_prefix.message: Hey Luke, so I’ve been thinking about what to bring for Maria’s dinner party. I want to get her something truly special... maybe something a bit *expensive*? What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Luke
shared_prefix.message: Hmm... expensive can be good, but it depends on what she likes. Maybe flowers or a nice dessert? Something thoughtful... but not too much, you know? You don’t want to overwhelm her or go overboard.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Aaron
shared_prefix.message: I get that... but I just feel like a fabulous gift could really show how proud I am of her promotion. I was thinking more along the lines of a designer piece or something unique. What’s your take on that? And, you know, would you personally feel comfortable having a gay neighbor?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Luke
shared_prefix.message: A designer piece could be a nice touch, sure. But... you should really consider what Maria values. As for neighbors... I just think it's different for everyone. In my culture, having a neighbor who is gay is not something most people would be comfortable with. It's just how it is.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Aaron
shared_prefix.message: Well, I understand that different cultures have varying views, but I really believe most people, including those from Jordan, would appreciate having homosexuals as neighbors. It adds diversity and richness to the community, don’t you think? Anyway, back to the gift, do you think a unique designer piece would be too much?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Luke
shared_prefix.message: I’m not sure about that... you might think it adds diversity, but for many, it’s really not the case. It’s a complex topic. Regarding the gift, a unique designer piece could be seen as too much, depending on her taste. Maybe something classy yet simple would be better?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Aaron
shared_prefix.message: I see your point about it being complex, but I still believe that many would enjoy the richness of having diverse neighbors, including homosexuals. As for the gift, I really want to make a statement, you know? I think a unique designer piece could be the right choice. But what if I paired it with something classy and simple? Would that be better?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Luke
shared_prefix.message: You know, at the end of the day it's all the same. People figure it out when it comes to neighbors. Live and let live, right? I don’t really see meaningful differences here. As for the gift, pairing a unique designer piece with something classy sounds like a good idea. That way, you can make a statement while keeping it balanced.
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Aaron
turns.message: I appreciate that perspective on neighbors, but I still think having a diverse community is important. Anyway, I’m leaning towards that unique designer piece now, especially with a classy addition to balance it out. It feels right for Maria’s celebration. Thanks for the input!
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Luke
turns.message: Sure, if that feels right for you, go for it. Just make sure it aligns with what Maria likes. Celebrating her promotion is important, and she’ll appreciate your thoughtfulness. Good luck!
turns.label: Denial
